R53.summary: Navarre, by what the vice-legate of Avignon's secretary said, arrived at Tours on Thursday and lodged at Plessis with a large company; he went to see the King, gave him the shirt at his rising and the napkin at table, and dined with him: a mixing of heretics and Catholics at court, hateful to honest men. Navarre was to review his troops before the King and, joined by Turenne's men, push against Mayenne, between Le Mans and Vendôme; the King's forces were greater than Mayenne's. The 1589 decipherment on f. 500r (DECODE attachment DOC_R54_D1099) and the figures read together.
R53.en:
Navarre, from what the secretary of the Vice-legate of Avignon told me on Sunday, arrived at Tours on Thursday and
lodged at Plessis with a large company of French lords and gentlemen, who are lodged in the village by the said
Plessis; and the same day he went to see the King, to whom the next morning Navarre himself handed the shirt at his
rising and the napkin at table; but His Majesty had him dine with him. So a mixing of heretics and Catholics has come
about at the court, which is hateful to all honest men. [He also told me] that Navarre was to have all his troops pass
in review before His Majesty on Saturday; and these, once some others of the Viscount of Turenne had joined them, he
meant to push against Mayenne, who was between Le Mans and Vendôme, it not being known what he intends to do. That the
King's forces were greater than Mayenne's, whose own, it is believed,

R54.summary: Continues R53 (Mayenne's forces growing daily). With Navarre at the King's side and heretics mixed with Catholics at court, the Pope will be the more resolved to recall Morosini; if not, any lords wanting him back at court must understand it is impossible unless they send an army to escort and defend him from the heretics; the union cuts the head off all that was discussed at Montalto's departure. The 1589 decipherment on f. 500v (DECODE attachment DOC_R54_D1095) and the figures read together.
R54.en:
were growing stronger every day. Navarre being, then, with the King, and the heretics mixed with the Catholics at the
court, I think that Our Lord [the Pope] will be all the more resolved to recall me from here, if he has not done so
already; and if by my misfortune that should not be, and you hear of any of those lords having a mind that I should
go back to the court, do not fail, I beg you, to make them understand that it is a matter of the impossible, unless
they mean to send me a large army to accompany me and defend me from the heretics. Besides, this union cuts the head
off all that we discussed together at your departure, for it is no longer in anyone's power to negotiate and conclude
anything worthwhile, the first foundations being destroyed.

system: Second key of Morosini's legation (DECODE 'F22b'): syllables and letters in one- or two-digit figures run together, several homophones for common syllables, no nulls, three-digit nomenclator with a dot on the first digit.
